name: Dropper to Dispenser
summary: Lets you turn a dropper into a dispenser without crafting one from scratch.

vanilla_changes.change: Shaped: dropper in the centre, sticks in a column on its left and 3 string in a column on its right (' S/' / 'S#/' / ' S/' with S = stick, / = string, # = dropper) -> dispenser. This is the bow's component layout around a dropper.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Part of the bundled VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks datapack (version 26.2 selection). Recipes are server-side; the datapack is loaded via Paxi.
